brief:
Buildable Creator Guide
Your job: Make a 15–45 sec video as a small business owner who got a pro website 
with Buildable. Send people to buildable.global.
Get Paid
$20 bonus
for your first approved video
Video Checklist
$25 bonus
for posting 10 times in one week (warm
up posts don't count)
15–45 seconds, vertical, 1080p+
Well-lit, front-facing, no glare or blur. You don’t need to show your face.
Clear audio, clear English
Put this link in your bio: https://www.buildable.global/#/business/claim
Write your own caption + hashtags
Who You’re Talking To
Small local trades (1–10 employees) with no website or an outdated one: plumbers, 
HVAC, electricians, roofers, landscapers, painters, pest control, locksmiths,
handymen.
Pick ONE trade per video and say it out loud: "If you’re a plumber losing jobs to 
companies with better websites…"
The 7 Beats (use every time)
1. Hook: Your name + trade. "I’m Eddie, and I’m a handyman."
2. Problem: Clip of you working. Voiceover: no website or a bad one.
3. Meet Buildable: "I filled out one form and in 30 minutes I had a custom website."
4. Before → After: Show no site/bad site → clean site.
5. Result: "Now my company shows up when you Google it."
6. Benefit: Pick one: more calls, more trust, looks professional, higher rates.
7. CTA: "Stop losing customers because they can’t find you online. Go to 
buildable.global."
Tone: A friend sharing a tip, not an ad. Skip the "AI" talk.
Never
• False claims about features, pricing, or results
• Blurry, dark, or noisy footage
• Copyrighted music, video, or images
• Profanity, politics, or religion
• Watermarks or competitor logos
• Copying another creator’s video
Warm Up Your Page
Post each example video on your page ONE time to warm up your account. Don’t 
copy them for your own videos.
1. https://youtube.com/shorts/0ynr6GtWMck
2. https://youtube.com/shorts/amTUJDuEbFM

5. https://youtube.com/shorts/qJRw27yP28g
6. https://youtube.com/shorts/SC4ZTdjDA04
7. https://youtube.com/shorts/-XduNymBtqo

Audio Recording (Ad 3 Sept-17-26).MP3
Audio Recording (Ad 2 Sept-17-26).MP3
Audio Recording (Ad 3 Aug-26).MP3

Audio Recording (Ad 4 Aug-26).MP3
Audio Recording (Ad 2 Aug-26).MP3
Screen Recordings You Can Use
https://www.buildable.global/assets/story-restaurant-r5R-FMD6.webp
https://www.buildable.global/assets/story-photography-BjsKYu6I.webp
How It Works
1. Film it
2. Write your caption
3. Submit for review
4. Wait for approval. Don’t post before you’re approved.
5. Post and check your bio
Top reasons for rejection: hard-to-understand speech, blurry/dark video, bad audio, 
no Buildable mention, posting before approval.
Bonus Industries
Screen printing, embroidery, signs, vehicle wraps, promo products, CNC, metal 
fabrication, packaging, commercial printing, industrial equipment, commercial HVAC, 
fire protection, commercial pest control, commercial cleaning, commercial landscaping, 
waste management, security integrators, 3PL, uniform and linen, equipment rental.
